description: Every form registered in the Pokemon Dusk Reborn Pokedex for one base species: colored forms (Shadow, Haunted, Frost, Glitter, Demon, Golden, Eternal, Baby, Shiny), Mega and Unbound forms, each with its exact in-game name, color, form type and artwork URL. This lists what exists in the game, not how many players own.

species.description: The base species name, such as "Mew", "Lugia" or "Rayquaza". Not a colored form.

name: get_pokedex_variants
title: List every registered form of a Pokemon
